item.g:title: Bambu Lab A2L - Combo (printer + AMS lite)

Its 330 x 320 x 325 mm build volume is more than double the A1's, while keeping the same easy A-series experience: fully automatic calibration, including flow-dynamics calibration before each print, a quick-swap 0.4 mm nozzle (0.2 to 0.8 mm available), a built-in filament cutter and a touchscreen. item.g:title: Bambu Lab P1S
item.g:description: The Bambu Lab P1S is the enclosed P-series printer that made fast, reliable printing easy. The closed chamber with an activated-carbon filter keeps temperatures steady, so it prints ABS and ASA as well as PLA, PETG and TPU. It reaches 500 mm/s with 20,000 mm/s² acceleration on a CoreXY motion system, with automatic bed leveling, vibration compensation and a built-in camera for watching prints from the Bambu Handy app. This is the printer only: add an AMS (sold separately) any time to print in multiple colors.

item.g:title: Bambu Lab X2D AMS Combo
item.g:description: The Bambu Lab X2D packs dual-nozzle printing into a compact, enclosed body that fits on a desk. Two nozzles print two materials or colors in one job with much less waste, across a 256 x 256 x 260 mm build volume. A 300 °C hot end, a 120 °C bed and an actively heated chamber (up to 65 °C) handle engineering materials, with HEPA and activated-carbon filtration and quiet running below 50 dB. A servo-driven main extruder, AI error detection and 1,000 mm/s top speed keep prints fast and clean. The AMS Combo includes the AMS 2 Pro for multi-color printing, which also dries filament at up to 65 °C.

item.g:title: Bambu Lab H2S AMS Combo
item.g:description: The Bambu Lab H2S brings the H2 series' large, enclosed platform to a single nozzle, for anyone who needs big parts printed fast. Its 340 x 320 x 340 mm build volume fits large models, cosplay and prototypes in one piece. A 350 °C hardened-steel hot end, a 120 °C bed and an actively heated chamber (up to 65 °C) handle engineering materials, with HEPA and activated-carbon filtration. A servo extruder with closed-loop control, vision-based motion calibration, AI error detection along the whole filament path and 1,000 mm/s top speed keep it fast and reliable. The AMS Combo includes the AMS 2 Pro for printing in multiple colors, which also dries filament at up to 65 °C.

item.g:title: Bambu Lab H2D AMS Combo
item.g:description: The Bambu Lab H2D is a large dual-nozzle printer for studios, workshops and businesses. Two nozzles print two materials in one job, such as a part with dissolvable supports or two colors with far less waste, across a 350 x 320 x 325 mm build volume. A 350 °C hardened-steel hot end, a 120 °C bed and an actively heated chamber (up to 65 °C) handle engineering materials including PA, PC and carbon-fiber composites, with HEPA and activated-carbon filtration. Servo extruders with closed-loop control, vision-based motion calibration and 1,000 mm/s top speed keep prints fast and precise. The AMS Combo includes the AMS 2 Pro, which also dries filament at up to 65 °C.

item.g:title: Bambu Lab X1E Combo
item.g:description: The Bambu Lab X1E is the enterprise edition of the X1 series, built for workshops, schools and companies that print engineering materials. An actively heated chamber (up to 60 °C), a 320 °C hardened-steel hot end and a 120 °C bed handle PA, PC, PET and carbon- or glass-fiber composites, while HEPA and activated-carbon filtration keep the air clean. It adds the security a business network needs: Ethernet as well as Wi-Fi, WPA2-Enterprise and LAN-only mode. Lidar and AI checks catch problems early. The Combo includes the AMS for printing in up to 4 colors or materials, with automatic spool switching.

item.g:title: Creality SparkX i7 - SparkX i7
item.g:description: The Creality SparkX i7 is a smart, easy way to get started in 3D printing. It's well suited to figurines, gifts, prototypes and custom parts without complicated setup — a good fit for the home, students, hobbyists, and testing custom product ideas before scaling up to higher-end printers. item.g:title: Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2
item.g:description: The Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 is an enclosed CoreXY 3D printer suited to anyone who wants speed, quality, and multi-color printing at a competitive price. An excellent choice for projects, prototypes, custom products, figurines, and functional parts. It comes with the CANVAS system for multi-color printing with up to 4 filaments, a hardened-steel nozzle rated for high temperatures, a practical build volume, and strong speed suited to daily use and light-to-medium production. Why choose it: multi-color printing via the CANVAS system (up to 4 filaments), high nozzle temperature up to 350°C for a wider range of materials, strong speed up to 500 mm/s with acceleration up to 20,000 mm/s², a practical 256 mm cubed build volume suited to most projects, business-friendly for producing models, products, gifts, and custom parts, and an easy experience with a 5-inch touchscreen, Wi-Fi, and automatic bed leveling. item.g:description: The Snapmaker U1 is a distinctive 3D printer for anyone who wants to get into multi-color printing in a way that's stronger than traditional filament-swap systems. It uses a multi-toolhead system, giving you a faster, cleaner color experience and opening the door to printing products, figurines, logos, gifts and creative pieces at high quality. Well suited to content creators, retailers, serious hobbyists, and anyone who wants an eye-catching printer that helps them produce colorful, sellable ideas. Why choose it: color without heavy waste — a multi-toolhead system that reduces filament waste compared to some color-swap systems; a different experience for anyone who wants new ideas and colorful products; excellent speed suited to daily production and colorful orders; a practical build volume suited to gifts, figurines and products; and a CoreXY design for better stability and speed for a professional printing experience.

item.g:title: Flashforge Adventurer 5M
item.g:description: The Flashforge Adventurer 5M is a strong option for anyone entering 3D printing who wants a fast, easy experience from the first day. It combines quality with high speed, stability, and simple operation, opening the door to printing figurines, products, gifts, prototypes and custom parts at excellent quality without complexity. Whether you use it at home, in a shop, or for university projects, the printer gives you a smooth experience thanks to its CoreXY system, automatic leveling, and quick-swap nozzle. Why choose it: faster printing with movement speed up to 600 mm/s, easy operation suited to beginners and professionals with automatic leveling and simple setup, consistent results from a CoreXY metal frame, easier maintenance with a quick-release nozzle, well suited to figurines, products, models and everyday parts, and a smart experience with filament run-out sensing and power-loss print recovery.

item.g:title: Flashforge Creator 5 Pro
item.g:description: The Flashforge Creator 5 Pro is a strong option for anyone moving into a more professional stage of 3D printing who needs multiple colors and materials in the same project. It combines 4 independent toolheads, an enclosed and heated print chamber, and high speed, opening the door to printing products, engineering models, multi-color figurines and parts in different materials efficiently with less waste. Whether you use it in a workshop, a shop, or daily production, the printer gives you a professional experience thanks to independent toolheads, automatic calibration, a built-in camera, and support for advanced engineering materials. Why choose it: multiple colors and materials with 4 independent toolheads letting you print in more than one color or material without constant swapping, less waste by reducing the need to purge filament between color changes compared to traditional swap systems, faster production with movement speed up to 600 mm/s and acceleration up to 30,000 mm/s², professional-grade materials with a heated chamber and hot end up to 320°C to support more engineering materials, well suited to selling and production for multi-color products, models, engineering parts and commercial projects, and a smart experience with automatic calibration, a Full HD camera, a filament sensor, and air filtration.

item.g:title: PLA+ Filament 1kg - Black
item.g:description: A 1 kg spool of 1.75 mm PLA+ filament for everyday 3D printing, available in eight colors: black, gray, yellow, orange, white, sky blue, turquoise green and red. PLA+ is an enhanced PLA: it keeps everything that makes PLA easy to print, with no enclosure needed, very low warping and clean, detailed results, while being tougher and less brittle than standard PLA, so parts hold up better in daily use. It works with almost any FDM printer, including Bambu Lab, Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic and Flashforge machines, and suits figurines, decor, gifts, keychains, functional parts, prototypes and multi-color prints with an AMS or similar system. The filament comes on a cardboard reel. For best results, keep it dry: store it sealed with desiccant after use, and dry it before printing if it has absorbed moisture.

item.g:title: A1 Series Extruder Unit
item.g:description: The extruder unit for the Bambu Lab A1 series is built to feed filament into the hot end with strength and stability. It uses hardened-steel dual gears to increase feed force, reduce slipping, and raise wear resistance during printing. This unit helps the printer handle tougher, more abrasive materials such as carbon-fiber-reinforced nylon or glass-fiber nylon, depending on printer settings and material. Why you need it: hardened-steel gears for higher feed force and better wear resistance, reduced filament slipping for stable material flow while printing, suited to tougher materials like Carbon Fiber Nylon and Glass Fiber Nylon depending on settings, a built-in filament cutter to help purge or swap filament, and a built-in extruder motor that provides the power needed for feeding. Box contents: 1x Extruder Unit (including filament cutter and extruder motor), 2x M2-2 Screws, 2x BT2-3 Screws, 2x M3-10 Screws.

item.g:title: Filament Cutter Lever
item.g:description: The filament cutter lever mounts on the extruder assembly and is used to hold the cutter and the cut-detection magnet in place. During the cutting action, the lever is pressed, and after the filament is cut, the lever returns to its original position. Why you need it: holds the cutter in place during operation, supports cut detection by carrying the detection magnet, automatically returns to its base position after cutting, and is an important maintenance part to replace if it breaks or cutting issues appear. Box contents: 1x Filament Cutter Lever. Note: it's best to inspect and replace the filament cutter lever when signs of breakage appear or when there are issues with the cutting process — follow Bambu Lab's official installation steps when replacing it.

item.g:title: Hotend Heating Assembly — A1 Series
item.g:description: The heating assembly for the Bambu Lab A1 series is built to support the hot end's quick-swap system. It uses a quick-fit mechanism to secure the heating block and heating base, making it easy to separate the thermal part from the electronic components during maintenance or replacement. The assembly can heat the hot end up to 300°C and instantly measures hot end temperature through its included thermistor. Why you need it: supports quick swapping for easy hot end removal and installation, heats up to 300°C suited to the temperatures A1 series materials need, instant temperature reading via a built-in thermistor while printing, and easier maintenance by separating the thermal part from the electronics practically. Box contents: 1x Hotend Heating Assembly, 3x BT3-10 Screws.

item.g:title: Bambu Lab AMS 2 Pro
item.g:description: The AMS 2 Pro is Bambu Lab's automatic material system for multi-color and multi-material printing. It holds four spools in a sealed box and switches between them automatically during a print, with RFID to recognise Bambu filament. It also dries filament with active moisture discharge at up to 65 °C, and shows temperature and humidity on the printer, in Bambu Studio and in Bambu Handy. A brushless servo feed motor makes it quieter and more reliable. Connect up to 4 AMS 2 Pro and 8 AMS HT units for up to 24 filaments. Works with Bambu Lab printers; some models need extra accessories, sold separately.

item.g:title: Bambu Lab AMS HT
item.g:description: The AMS HT is Bambu Lab's single-spool automatic material unit for high-temperature drying. It keeps one spool sealed and dries it at up to 85 °C with active moisture discharge and a rotating drying mode, which suits moisture-sensitive engineering filaments such as PA, PC and PET. A screen shows temperature, humidity and the drying time left. Like the AMS 2 Pro it feeds filament to the printer automatically, with RFID and a brushless servo feed motor, and a bypass outlet for flexible and fiber-filled filaments. Chain up to 8 AMS HT with up to 4 AMS 2 Pro for up to 24 filaments. Some printers need extra accessories, sold separately.

item.g:title: Bambu Lab AMS lite
item.g:description: The AMS lite is Bambu Lab's automatic material system for the A-series. It holds four spools on an open, compact stand and switches between them automatically during a print, so an A1, A1 mini or A2L can print in up to four colors or materials without you changing spools by hand. RFID reads Bambu Lab filament and fills in the settings for you. Add it to a printer you already own to turn it into a Combo.

item.g:title: Oni Mask PS5 Controller Stand
item.g:description: An original oni-mask controller stand, designed and 3D printed in-house at Black Arrow 3D. The fierce Japanese demon face, with bared fangs and a snarling expression, is sculpted to cradle a PS5 DualSense controller by its handles, so the controller sits upright like a crown on the mask. Two screw-thread support legs at the back keep it stable on your desk. It is printed in PLA and finished in a raw, unpainted grey, which shows off the sculpted detail and leaves it ready to paint in your own colors if you like. A striking piece for a gaming setup, streaming desk or shelf, and a great gift for gamers.

Your PS5 DualSense controller rests on top of the crown, keeping it displayed and within reach. item.g:title: This Is Sparta! King Leonidas Kick Edge Display
item.g:description: Put the most famous kick in movie history on your shelf. King Leonidas stands on the very edge of your desk, shelf or 3D printer, cape flying, sword in hand and mouth open mid-roar, while his kick sends the cloaked messenger falling backwards off the edge into thin air. The figures connect only at the kick, so the messenger seems to hang in mid-fall, which is what makes this piece stop people in their tracks. Printed in-house at Black Arrow 3D in two contrasting colours, stone grey for Leonidas and black for the messenger, with fine sculpted detail in the muscles, the torn battle kilt, the greaves and the flowing robes. Leonidas stands on a small flat base that sits right at the edge, and the messenger hangs out over the drop. A bold conversation piece for a desk, bookshelf, gaming setup or printer top, and a great gift for any fan of the film.

item.g:title: One Piece Straw Hat Jolly Roger Keychain
item.g:description: Fly the Straw Hat Pirates' flag wherever you go. This keychain recreates Luffy's famous Jolly Roger from One Piece: the grinning white skull wearing the yellow straw hat with its red band, crossed bones behind it, all set inside a black circle with a white ring. Every colour is printed as its own raised layer, so the hat, band, skull and bones stand out crisply from the black background with clean, sharp edges and no paint to chip or fade. Printed in-house at Black Arrow 3D in durable PLA, with a hole at the top and a metal keyring so it goes straight onto your keys, bag or backpack zip. A perfect small gift for any One Piece fan, and an easy add-on to any order.
